# goslop text fixture — specific exception type (not Exception/BaseException)
# so CWE-396 (declaration of generic catch) is silent. A single wrapped raise
# of a more specific type is still a CWE-396 hit when the catch is Exception
# (see CWE-396-batch3-reraise-from-vulnerable / voicetag TPs).
lang: python
file: CWE-396-batch3-reraise-from-safe.py
---
class DomainError(Exception):
    pass

def load_pipeline(name):
    try:
        return build(name)
    except OSError as exc:
        raise DomainError(f"Failed to load pipeline: {exc}") from exc
